title: Section adjunction and scalar normalization for ordinary quotient realization
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $A$ a commutative ring, $J$ an ideal of $A$, and $U$ an object of the coefficient-sized pro-etale site. Let $T$ be its slice site at $U$, $B_n$ the restriction to $T$ of the constant ring sheaf $A/J^{n+1}$, and $F_n:\operatorname{Mod}_A\to\operatorname{Mod}(B_n)$ the ordinary completed quotient realization [def-sfb-adic-perfect-module-functors, def-sfb-adic-perfect-reduction-model-complexes]. Let $G$ send an $A$-module to sections of its constant module sheaf at the terminal object of $T$, retaining the $A$-action, and put $H_n(M)=G(M/J^{n+1}M)$ [def-sfb-adic-short-complex-quotient-tower]. Write $C_n$ for scalar extension from $B_{n+1}$ to $B_n$ and $\theta_n:F_{n+1}C_n\simeq F_n$ for the fixed ordinary balancing isomorphism. There exist right adjoints $R_n$ with adjunctions $a_n:F_n\dashv R_n$, natural isomorphisms $e_n:H_n\simeq F_nR_n$, and natural transformations $\kappa_n:R_{n+1}\to C_nR_n$ such that, for every $M$, the lower adjunction unit equals the upper unit followed by $\kappa_n(F_{n+1}M)$ and $R_n(\theta_n(M))$. Moreover the canonical successor section transition $\delta_n(M):H_{n+1}(M)\to H_n(M)$ followed by $e_n(M)$ equals $e_{n+1}(M)$ followed by the same $\kappa_n(F_{n+1}M)$ and $R_n(\theta_n(M))$. These are statements about scalar realization and sections of individual modules; no comparison on modules of linear maps or bijectivity of a Hom comparison is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem adicPerfectQuotientSectionAdjunction (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X) :
    let G := AdicCohomology.sections
      ((coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).over U) (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let H := fun n : ℕ ↦ AdicCohomology.quotient J (n + 1) ⋙ G
    let F := fun n : ℕ ↦ adicPerfectQuotientFunctor X J U n
    ∃ (R : ∀ n : ℕ,
        Mod ((finite (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J n).over U) ⥤
          ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
      (a : ∀ n : ℕ, F n ⊣ R n)
      (e : ∀ n : ℕ, H n ≅ F n ⋙ R n)
      (κ : ∀ n : ℕ, R (n + 1) ⟶
        change (adicPerfectQuotientScalarStep X J U n) ⋙ R n),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A),
        (a n).unit.app M = (a (n + 1)).unit.app M ≫
          (κ n).app ((F (n + 1)).obj M) ≫
            (R n).map ((adicPerfectQuotientModuleStep X J U n).hom.app M)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A),
        G.map ((AdicCohomology.transition J
          (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_succ n) 1)).app M) ≫ (e n).hom.app M =
          (e (n + 1)).hom.app M ≫ (κ n).app ((F (n + 1)).obj M) ≫
            (R n).map ((adicPerfectQuotientModuleStep X J U n).hom.app M))
